summary: A user reported being introduced by an online acquaintance to a so called professional trader who directed funds from Binance P2P to a platform named starlinkchain com for ETH USDT trading with promised profits. The site was newly created and commenters identified the scheme as a fake trading dashboard used to simulate gains and solicit deposits.
user_mistake: Considered transferring funds to a trading platform introduced by an online acquaintance promising profit sharing
prevention: Refuse to deposit funds into trading platforms introduced through online relationships / Verify platform registration history and regulatory presence before transferring assets
